verdict.rationale: Visa ships an official TypeScript Agent Toolkit that integrates with the Vercel AI SDK, and its MCP package is published on npm under Visa-staff maintainers. However, the toolkit documents only Pay by Link and Invoicing tools. The core Intelligent Commerce capabilities (tokens, instructions, credentials) are documented only as raw REST endpoints, and the TAP repo is a reference implementation rather than an SDK. Missing for 10: an official SDK covering the Intelligent Commerce APIs, multi-language SDKs, SDK reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The toolkit is built in TypeScript, and you can integrate it with the Vercel AI SDK or use it to access a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
The specialized tools in the toolkit are designed to enable your AI agents to utilize the Pay by Link and Invoicing APIs.
the Visa Acceptance Agent Toolkit MCP server resolves on the public npm registry (npm view @visaacceptance/mcp → 0.0.96, Visa-staff maintainers)
